Score County-Level Nutrient Recovery Hub Sites

Source: R/hub_functions.R
score_hub_sites.Rd

Implements a 3-scenario x 3-nutrient scoring framework to rank all CONUS counties as potential nutrient recovery hub locations. Takes the output of run_builtin_analysis directly; year and spatial scale are controlled upstream.

Usage

score_hub_sites(
  ms_output,
  cafo_data = NULL,
  cdl_path = NULL,
  catchment_miles = 50,
  scores = "all",
  top_n = 10,
  cdl_aggregate_factor = 10,
  n_threads = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

ms_output

List. Output of run_builtin_analysis( scale = "county", include_wwtp = TRUE).

cafo_data

Character, data.frame, or NULL. Local path to cafo.rds / cafo.csv, a data.frame, or NULL to auto-download. Must contain lon / lat columns (WGS84).

cdl_path

Character or NULL. CONUS CDL GeoTIFF (30 m). When supplied: (1) refines demand by cropland intensity, and (2) adds top-3 crop type profiles for every top-N county. Requires terra and exactextractr.

catchment_miles

Numeric. Catchment radius in miles for transport centrality, demand calculations, and crop profile buffers. Default 50.

scores

Character vector or "all". Scores to compute. Default "all".

top_n

Integer. Top-ranked sites per score. Default 10.

cdl_aggregate_factor

Integer. CDL aggregation factor for intensity fraction calculation. Default 10 (30 m -> 300 m). The original (non-aggregated) raster is used for crop profile extraction to preserve crop-type detail.

n_threads

Integer. Threads for terra. Default 1.

verbose

Logical. Default TRUE.

Value

A list of class "manureshed_hub" with elements master, scored_sf, top_n, robustness, cafo_validation, score_registry, params. When CDL is supplied, each top_n table includes a top3_crops column listing the dominant crop types within the catchment radius.

Performance

A single county-to-county distance matrix is computed once and reused for all catchment calculations, minimising expensive spatial operations.

CDL usage

When cdl_path is supplied the CDL raster is used for two purposes:

  1. Cropland intensity fraction per county, which weights the demand signal (all counties).

  2. Top-3 dominant crop types within catchment_miles of each top-N hub county, added as a top3_crops column in every top_n table.

Scoring framework

NPN & P
S1 AgScore 1Score 2Score 3
S2 WWTPScore 4Score 5Score 6
S3 Ag+WWTPScore 7Score 8Score 9 *

Score 9 (8 equal-weight dimensions) is the flagship recommendation.

See also

download_cafo_data, map_hub_sites, export_hub_results

ms  <- run_builtin_analysis("county", 2016,
         c("nitrogen","phosphorus"), include_wwtp = TRUE)
